purpose: Synthetic architecture example; not GPIF extraction, implemented inverse, detected phrases or validated music.

rules.pattern: onset = occurrence.start + relative_onset; duration = pattern.duration; pitch = first_pitch + relative_pitch + occurrence_delta
rules.bend: sounding pitch = written base + curve displacement; mark unknown physical details explicitly
rules.tier_access: inputs references preceding tier only; every output carries prior typed records, not source blobs
rules.limits: Same-tier descriptive links are not extra forward inputs. No inverse or variation is executed.

cases.title: 🔁 Follow the idea
cases.explains: The same E call returns. The answer changes from a bent A to a written B with vibrato.
cases.preserve: Exact note members, timing, initial pitch, curve and per-occurrence differences. A shared pattern does not erase exceptions.

cases.title: 🎸 Techniques / overlapping voices
cases.explains: Notation connects actual events: tie destinations are not new attacks; two voices can overlap; techniques have physical endpoints.
cases.preserve: Individual written segments, voice identity, string/fret, technique curves and unknown vibrato depth/rate.

cases.title: ⏱️ Tuplets / repeats / tempo
cases.explains: 8 written bars produce 10 playback visits. Bar 7 is 3/4; the return slows from 100 to 80 BPM.
cases.preserve: Exact 1/3-quarter durations, meter, repeat instructions and a separate playback-visit map.

cases.title: 📊 Counts / uncertainty
cases.explains: Statistics name their population. Repeated playback and tied segments must not inflate written attack counts.
cases.preserve: Evidence links, denominator policy and unknown interpretations. No guessed artist or emotional meaning.
